description: Uploads one file as a Polarion attachment to a Work Item, Test Run, LiveDoc, or Rich Page and returns the attachment result. Choose exactly one source: an absolute local path on stdio with `MCP_UPLOAD_ROOTS`, or an HTTPS URL on an allowlisted host with `MCP_UPLOAD_URL_HOSTS`. The authenticated Polarion user must have attachment write permission. Use `dry_run` to validate and preview name, size, and SHA-256; use the resource-specific attachment tools when editing existing attachment metadata or content.

dry_run.description: Preview file metadata and digest without sending an attachment request.

fileName.description: Optional attachment filename override without path separators; defaults to the source filename.

filePath.description: Absolute local file path, available only over stdio and only under a configured MCP_UPLOAD_ROOTS directory.

target.description: Polarion target reference; document and page targets also require spaceId.

id.description: Work Item, Test Run, document, or page ID within the project; do not include the project prefix.

projectId.description: Project ID that owns the target resource.

spaceId.description: Required for `document` and `page`; space ID within the project.

title.description: Optional attachment title stored by Polarion.

url.description: Absolute HTTPS URL whose hostname is listed in MCP_UPLOAD_URL_HOSTS; HTTP requires explicit server opt-in.

name: upload_attachment
title: Upload attachment
